params.message:
Patch sharp's libheif and the semver-safe advisories in the site's runtime

The critical runtime advisory on this site is GHSA-26w7-cxv4-gfx2: remote
code execution through a crafted AVIF image, via libheif inside sharp.
Astro only ships the fix in 7.2.8, three majors ahead of the 4.16.19 this
site runs. The vulnerable code is sharp's bundled libheif, and the SSR
function deploys sharp because Astro injects its /_image endpoint.

Pin sharp to 0.35.5 through an override (libheif 1.23.5, which carries the
libheif fixes) and take the in-range patches npm audit offers for devalue,
http-cache-semantics, js-yaml and source-map-js. No application code
changes; the prerendered output is byte-identical before and after.
